entries.justification: Design reference export (AI Studio single-file HTML) kept in the repository as the source of truth for the UI, not as application code. It is not imported from src/, not under public/, not listed in wrangler assets, and not copied by next build, so the flagged script never reaches a browser through this product. Accepted at level=error / security-severity 4.3. Revisit if the file is ever served, imported, or moved under public/.

Same artifact and same reasoning as the js/cross-window-information-leak entry above: the finding is inside a design reference export that is not shipped. Recorded separately because it is a different query at security-severity 7.8, and a single record per (path, ruleId) is what makes the consumption count mean anything. Revisit if the file is ever served, imported, or moved under public/.
